table.retrieve:
SELECT
//	username=T.UserName,
	itemcategory=T.itemcategory,
	AliasName = T.AliasName,
	ItemName = T.ItemName,
	itemcommperc=Max(T.itemcommperc),
	looseqty=sum(T.looseqty),
	NetSale=SUM(T.AfterItemdisctotal),
    commission2=(SUM(T.AfterItemdisctotal) *  Max(T.itemcommperc)*0.01),
	commissionperunit=SUM(T.commissionperunit),
	commissionperc=SUM(T.commissionperc),
	totalcommission=SUM(T.totalcommission)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		Type = 'Sales',
		username=(select username from users where users.usercode=SL.salesmancode),
		itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=I.icatcode),
		AliasName = I.CustomIcode,
		ItemName = I.Name,
		itemcommperc=max(I.commissionperc),
		looseqty=sum(SD.looseqty),
		AfterItemdisctotal=Round(sum(SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.saleprice*0.01*SD.discperc) - (SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc)),2),
		commissionperunit=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2),
		commissionperc=Round(sum((Round((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
		totalcommission=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2)  +  Round(sum((Round((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2)
	from saleledger SL,
		saledetail SD,
		item I
	where SL.date>=:ar_startdate   and
		SL.date<=:ar_enddate and
		SL.salesmancode IN (:ar_usercode) and
		SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
		SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
		SD.icode=I.icode
	group by SL.salesmancode, I.icatcode, I.CustomIcode, I.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		Type = 'Sales Return',
		username=(select username from users where users.usercode=SL.salesmancode),
		itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=I.icatcode),
		AliasName = I.CustomIcode,
		ItemName = I.Name,
		itemcommperc=max(I.commissionperc),
		looseqty = - sum(SD.looseqty),
		AfterItemdisctotal = - Round(sum(SD.looseqty*(SD.srprice - SD.srprice*0.01*SD.discperc)),2),
		commissionperunit = - Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2),
		commissionperc = - Round(sum((Round(SD.srprice*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
		totalcommission = - Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2)  +  Round(sum((Round(SD.srprice * (1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2)
	from srledger SL,
		srdetail SD,
		item I
	where SL.date>=:ar_startdate   and
		SL.date<=:ar_enddate and
		SL.salesmancode IN (:ar_usercode) and
		SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode and
		SD.icode=I.icode
	group by SL.salesmancode, I.icatcode, I.CustomIcode, I.Name) T
GROUP BY
//	T.UserName,
	T.itemcategory,
	T.AliasName,
	T.ItemName
